queries.sql: select "p".*, "c"."display_name", "c"."is_customer_active", "e"."name" as "business", "e"."active" as "entity_active" from "public"."recurring_customers" as "p" inner join "customers" as "c" on "c"."customer_id" = "p"."customer_id" and "c"."account_id" = "p"."account_id" left join "billing_entities" as "e" on "e"."billing_entity_id" = "p"."billing_entity_id" where "p"."account_id" = $1 and "p"."billing_entity_id" = $2 order by "p"."customer_id" asc, "p"."recurring_customer_id" asc

select "o".*, "t"."total_transaction" as "amount", "t"."detailed_work_description" as "description" from "recurring_charge_occurrences" as "o" left join "public"."customer_transactions" as "t" on "t"."transaction_id" = "o"."transaction_id" where "o"."account_id" = $1 and "o"."plan_id" in ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) order by "o"."plan_id" asc, "o"."period_start" asc
select * from "public"."billing_entities" where "account_id" = $1 and "billing_entity_id" = $2 limit $3
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

select "customer_transactions".*, (SELECT plan_id FROM public.recurring_charge_occurrences o WHERE o.transaction_id=customer_transactions.transaction_id) AS recurring_plan_id, customers.display_name as customer_name, users.display_name as logged_for_user_name, "customer_general_work_descriptions"."general_work_description", "customer_jobs"."job_type_id", "customer_job_types"."job_description" from "customer_transactions" inner join "customers" on "customer_transactions"."customer_id" = "customers"."customer_id" and "customers"."account_id" = "customer_transactions"."account_id" left join "users" on "customer_transactions"."logged_for_user_id" = "users"."user_id" and "users"."account_id" = "customer_transactions"."account_id" left join "customer_general_work_descriptions" on "customer_transactions"."general_work_description_id" = "customer_general_work_descriptions"."general_work_description_id" and "customer_general_work_descriptions"."account_id" = "customer_transactions"."account_id" left join "customer_jobs" on "customer_transactions"."customer_job_id" = "customer_jobs"."customer_job_id" and "customer_jobs"."account_id" = "customer_transactions"."account_id" and "customer_jobs"."customer_id" = "customer_transactions"."customer_id" left join "customer_job_types" on "customer_jobs"."job_type_id" = "customer_job_types"."job_type_id" and "customer_job_types"."account_id" = "customer_jobs"."account_id" where "customer_transactions"."account_id" = $1 and (("customer_jobs"."customer_job_id" is not null and "customer_job_types"."job_type_id" is not null and "users"."user_id" is not null and "customer_general_work_descriptions"."general_work_description_id" is not null) or exists (select 1 from "public"."recurring_charge_occurrences" as "ro" where ro.transaction_id=customer_transactions.transaction_id AND ro.account_id=customer_transactions.account_id AND ro.customer_id=customer_transactions.customer_id)) order by "customer_transactions"."created_at" desc

select "customer_invoices".*, customers.display_name as customer_name, users.display_name as created_by_user_name from "customer_invoices" inner join "customers" on "customer_invoices"."customer_id" = "customers"."customer_id" inner join "users" on "customer_invoices"."created_by_user_id" = "users"."user_id" where "customer_invoices"."account_id" = $1 order by "customer_invoices"."invoice_date" desc

select "customer_writeoffs".*, customers.display_name as customer_name, "customer_jobs"."job_type_id", "customer_job_types"."job_description", users.display_name as created_by_user_name from "customer_writeoffs" inner join "customers" on "customer_writeoffs"."customer_id" = "customers"."customer_id" left join "customer_jobs" on "customer_writeoffs"."customer_job_id" = "customer_jobs"."customer_job_id" left join "customer_job_types" on "customer_jobs"."job_type_id" = "customer_job_types"."job_type_id" inner join "users" on "customer_writeoffs"."created_by_user_id" = "users"."user_id" where "customer_writeoffs"."account_id" = $1

select "customer_payments".*, (SELECT coalesce(a.receipt_id,c.origin_receipt_id) FROM ar_applications a LEFT JOIN client_credit_lots c ON c.credit_id=a.credit_id WHERE a.account_id=customer_payments.account_id AND a.compatibility_payment_id=customer_payments.payment_id ORDER BY a.application_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS receipt_id, customers.display_name as customer_name, users.display_name as created_by_user_name from "customer_payments" inner join "customers" on "customer_payments"."customer_id" = "customers"."customer_id" inner join "users" on "customer_payments"."created_by_user_id" = "users"."user_id" where "customer_payments"."account_id" = $1 order by "customer_payments"."created_at" desc

select * from "retainer_events" as "e" where "e"."account_id" = $1 and not exists (select 1 from "customer_invoices" as "p" where p.account_id=e.account_id AND p.customer_id=e.customer_id AND p.parent_invoice_id IS NULL AND p.created_at >= e.created_at)

select * from "customers" inner join "customer_information" on "customers"."customer_id" = "customer_information"."customer_id" where "customers"."account_id" = $1 and "customers"."is_customer_active" = $2 and "customer_information"."is_this_address_active" = $3 and "customer_information"."account_id" = $4 order by "customers"."customer_name" asc

select "customer_retainers_and_prepayments".*, customers.display_name as customer_name, users.display_name as created_by_user_name from "customer_retainers_and_prepayments" inner join "customers" on "customer_retainers_and_prepayments"."customer_id" = "customers"."customer_id" inner join "users" on "customer_retainers_and_prepayments"."created_by_user_id" = "users"."user_id" where "customer_retainers_and_prepayments"."account_id" = $1 order by "customer_retainers_and_prepayments"."created_at" desc
select * from "public"."billing_entities" where "account_id" = $1 and "billing_entity_id" = $2 limit $3

select * from "client_refunds" as "c" where "c"."account_id" = $1 and "c"."customer_id" = $2 and "c"."billing_entity_id" = $3 and not exists (select 1 from "invoice_statement_members" as "m" where "m"."account_id" = $4 and "m"."table_name" = $5 and m.record_id=c.refund_id)

select * from "credit_memo_reversals" as "c" where "c"."account_id" = $1 and "c"."customer_id" = $2 and "c"."billing_entity_id" = $3 and not exists (select 1 from "invoice_statement_members" as "m" where "m"."account_id" = $4 and "m"."table_name" = $5 and m.record_id=c.reversal_id)

select * from "credit_memos" as "c" where "c"."account_id" = $1 and "c"."customer_id" = $2 and "c"."billing_entity_id" = $3 and not exists (select 1 from "invoice_statement_members" as "m" where "m"."account_id" = $4 and "m"."table_name" = $5 and m.record_id=c.memo_id)

select * from "invoice_voids" as "c" where "c"."account_id" = $1 and "c"."customer_id" = $2 and "c"."billing_entity_id" = $3 and not exists (select 1 from "invoice_statement_members" as "m" where "m"."account_id" = $4 and "m"."table_name" = $5 and m.record_id=c.void_id)
SELECT to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS cutoff

select * from "payment_receipts" where "account_id" = $1 and "customer_id" = $2 and "billing_entity_id" = $3 and "source_kind" = $4 and created_at > (SELECT created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' FROM public.customer_invoices WHERE customer_invoice_id=$5) and "receipt_date" <= $6 order by "receipt_id" asc

select "invoice_number" from "customer_invoices" where "account_id" = $1 and "parent_invoice_id" is null and invoice_number ~ $2 order by substring(invoice_number from '-([0-9]{5})$')::int DESC limit $3
select * from "payment_receipts" where "account_id" = $1 and "customer_id" = $2 and "billing_entity_id" = $3 and "source_kind" = $4 and "receipt_date" <= $5 order by "receipt_id" asc

select count(*) as "count" from "customers" as "c" left join (SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id)
                    customer_id,
                    audit_id AS last_audit_id,
                    created_at AS last_audit_at,
                    audit_balance AS last_audit_balance,
                    app_invoice_total AS last_app_invoice_total,
                    discrepancy_count AS last_discrepancy_count
                 FROM account_audits
                 WHERE account_id = $1 AND status = 'completed' AND billing_entity_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2
                 ORDER BY customer_id, created_at DESC, audit_id DESC) la on "la"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" where "c"."account_id" = $3 and "c"."is_customer_active" = $4 and (exists (select 1 from "customer_invoices" as "ci" where "ci"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" and "ci"."account_id" = $5 and ci.remaining_balance_on_invoice <> 0 and "ci"."is_invoice_paid_in_full" = $6 and "ci"."parent_invoice_id" is null) or exists (select 1 from "customer_transactions" as "ct" where "ct"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" and "ct"."account_id" = $7 and "ct"."is_transaction_billable" = $8 and "ct"."customer_invoice_id" is null)) and "la"."last_app_invoice_total" is not null and ABS(la.last_app_invoice_total) >= $9

select "c"."customer_id", "c"."display_name", "c"."customer_name", "c"."business_name", "c"."is_commercial_customer", "la"."last_audit_at", "la"."last_audit_id", "la"."last_audit_balance", "la"."last_app_invoice_total", "la"."last_discrepancy_count" from "customers" as "c" left join (SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id)
                    customer_id,
                    audit_id AS last_audit_id,
                    created_at AS last_audit_at,
                    audit_balance AS last_audit_balance,
                    app_invoice_total AS last_app_invoice_total,
                    discrepancy_count AS last_discrepancy_count
                 FROM account_audits
                 WHERE account_id = $1 AND status = 'completed' AND billing_entity_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2
                 ORDER BY customer_id, created_at DESC, audit_id DESC) la on "la"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" where "c"."account_id" = $3 and "c"."is_customer_active" = $4 and (exists (select 1 from "customer_invoices" as "ci" where "ci"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" and "ci"."account_id" = $5 and ci.remaining_balance_on_invoice <> 0 and "ci"."is_invoice_paid_in_full" = $6 and "ci"."parent_invoice_id" is null) or exists (select 1 from "customer_transactions" as "ct" where "ct"."customer_id" = "c"."customer_id" and "ct"."account_id" = $7 and "ct"."is_transaction_billable" = $8 and "ct"."customer_invoice_id" is null)) and "la"."last_app_invoice_total" is not null and ABS(la.last_app_invoice_total) >= $9 order by c.display_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC limit $10

WITH 
         current_chains AS (
            -- Every parent dated on the customer's newest statement date, with
            -- the chain's LATEST snapshot remaining (parent row when no snapshots).
            SELECT sp.customer_id,
                   sp.statement_date,
                   COALESCE(latest_child.remaining_balance_on_invoice, sp.remaining_balance_on_invoice)::numeric AS remaining
            FROM (
               SELECT ci.customer_id,
                      ci.customer_invoice_id,
                      ci.invoice_date,
                      ci.remaining_balance_on_invoice,
                      MAX(ci.invoice_date) OVER (PARTITION BY ci.customer_id) AS statement_date
               FROM customer_invoices ci
               WHERE ci.account_id = $1
                 AND ci.parent_invoice_id IS NULL
                 
            ) sp
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
               SELECT ch.remaining_balance_on_invoice
               FROM customer_invoices ch
               WHERE ch.account_id = $2
                 AND ch.parent_invoice_id = sp.customer_invoice_id
               ORDER BY ch.created_at DESC, ch.customer_invoice_id DESC
               LIMIT 1
            ) latest_child ON true
            WHERE sp.invoice_date = sp.statement_date
         ),
         customer_balance AS (
            SELECT customer_id,
                   statement_date,
                   SUM(remaining) AS total_outstanding,
                   COUNT(*)::int AS statement_count,
                   EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - statement_date))::int AS days_old
            FROM current_chains
            GROUP BY customer_id, statement_date
            HAVING SUM(remaining) <> 0
         ),
         customer_aging AS (
            SELECT
               customer_id,
               total_outstanding,
               CASE WHEN days_old <= 30 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_0_30,
               CASE WHEN days_old BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_31_60,
               CASE WHEN days_old BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_61_90,
               CASE WHEN days_old > 90 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_over_90,
               days_old AS oldest_days,
               statement_date,
               statement_count
            FROM customer_balance
         )
         SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count
         FROM customers c
         JOIN customer_aging ca ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id
         WHERE c.account_id = $3

WITH 
         current_chains AS (
            -- Every parent dated on the customer's newest statement date, with
            -- the chain's LATEST snapshot remaining (parent row when no snapshots).
            SELECT sp.customer_id,
                   sp.statement_date,
                   COALESCE(latest_child.remaining_balance_on_invoice, sp.remaining_balance_on_invoice)::numeric AS remaining
            FROM (
               SELECT ci.customer_id,
                      ci.customer_invoice_id,
                      ci.invoice_date,
                      ci.remaining_balance_on_invoice,
                      MAX(ci.invoice_date) OVER (PARTITION BY ci.customer_id) AS statement_date
               FROM customer_invoices ci
               WHERE ci.account_id = $1
                 AND ci.parent_invoice_id IS NULL
                 
            ) sp
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
               SELECT ch.remaining_balance_on_invoice
               FROM customer_invoices ch
               WHERE ch.account_id = $2
                 AND ch.parent_invoice_id = sp.customer_invoice_id
               ORDER BY ch.created_at DESC, ch.customer_invoice_id DESC
               LIMIT 1
            ) latest_child ON true
            WHERE sp.invoice_date = sp.statement_date
         ),
         customer_balance AS (
            SELECT customer_id,
                   statement_date,
                   SUM(remaining) AS total_outstanding,
                   COUNT(*)::int AS statement_count,
                   EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - statement_date))::int AS days_old
            FROM current_chains
            GROUP BY customer_id, statement_date
            HAVING SUM(remaining) <> 0
         ),
         customer_aging AS (
            SELECT
               customer_id,
               total_outstanding,
               CASE WHEN days_old <= 30 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_0_30,
               CASE WHEN days_old BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_31_60,
               CASE WHEN days_old BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_61_90,
               CASE WHEN days_old > 90 THEN total_outstanding ELSE 0 END AS bucket_over_90,
               days_old AS oldest_days,
               statement_date,
               statement_count
            FROM customer_balance
         ),
         billed_charges AS (
            -- Billed billable charges, newest first, with the running total of
            -- this charge and every newer one (FIFO walk for the real age).
            SELECT ct.customer_id,
                   ct.transaction_date,
                   ct.total_transaction::numeric AS amount,
                   SUM(ct.total_transaction::numeric) OVER (
                      PARTITION BY ct.customer_id
                      ORDER BY ct.transaction_date DESC, ct.transaction_id DESC
                      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                   ) AS this_and_newer
            FROM customer_transactions ct
            JOIN customer_aging ca0 ON ca0.customer_id = ct.customer_id
            WHERE ct.account_id = $3
              AND ct.customer_invoice_id IS NOT NULL
              AND ct.is_transaction_billable = true
              AND ct.total_transaction > 0
         ),
         oldest_open AS (
            -- A charge is still (partly) unpaid under FIFO when the charges
            -- newer than it do not yet cover the outstanding balance.
            SELECT bc.customer_id, MIN(bc.transaction_date) AS oldest_open_charge_date
            FROM billed_charges bc
            JOIN customer_aging ca1 ON ca1.customer_id = bc.customer_id
            WHERE bc.this_and_newer - bc.amount < ca1.total_outstanding
            GROUP BY bc.customer_id
         ),
         last_payment AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id)
               customer_id,
               payment_date,
               ABS(payment_amount) AS payment_amount
            FROM customer_payments
            WHERE account_id = $4
            ORDER BY customer_id, payment_date DESC, payment_id DESC
         )
         SELECT
            c.customer_id,
            c.display_name,
            c.business_name,
            c.customer_name,
            c.is_commercial_customer,
            c.is_customer_active,
            ca.total_outstanding::numeric AS total_outstanding,
            ca.bucket_0_30::numeric AS bucket_0_30,
            ca.bucket_31_60::numeric AS bucket_31_60,
            ca.bucket_61_90::numeric AS bucket_61_90,
            ca.bucket_over_90::numeric AS bucket_over_90,
            ca.oldest_days,
            ca.statement_date AS most_recent_invoice_date,
            ca.statement_date,
            ca.statement_count,
            oo.oldest_open_charge_date,
            CASE WHEN oo.oldest_open_charge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
                 ELSE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - oo.oldest_open_charge_date))::int
            END AS oldest_open_charge_days,
            lp.payment_date AS last_payment_date,
            lp.payment_amount AS last_payment_amount,
            EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM customer_transactions ct
               WHERE ct.customer_id = c.customer_id
                 AND ct.account_id = $5
                 AND ct.is_transaction_billable = true
                 AND (lp.payment_date IS NULL OR ct.transaction_date > lp.payment_date)
            ) AS has_work_since_last_payment
         FROM customers c
         JOIN customer_aging ca ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id
         LEFT JOIN oldest_open oo ON oo.customer_id = c.customer_id
         LEFT JOIN last_payment lp ON lp.customer_id = c.customer_id
         WHERE c.account_id = $6
           
           
         ORDER BY ca.oldest_days DESC NULLS LAST, ca.total_outstanding DESC, c.customer_id ASC
         LIMIT $7 OFFSET $8
